description: This file contains utility functions for generating OpenAPI specifications in FastAPI, including handling security definitions, parameters, request bodies, responses, and paths, as well as extracting route-related model fields.

methods.name: get_openapi_security_definitions
methods.description: Generates security definitions and security requirements for an OpenAPI operation based on the provided dependencies.

methods.name: _get_openapi_operation_parameters
methods.description: Collects and constructs OpenAPI parameter objects from route dependencies, including path, query, header, and cookie parameters.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_request_body
methods.description: Creates the OpenAPI requestBody object from a Pydantic model field.

methods.name: generate_operation_id
methods.description: Generates a unique operationId for an API route, deprecated in favor of other mechanisms.

methods.name: generate_operation_summary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for an API route, defaulting to the route name.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_metadata
methods.description: Builds the metadata object for an OpenAPI operation, including tags, summary, description, operationId, and deprecation status.

methods.name: get_openapi_path
methods.description: Constructs the OpenAPI path item object for a given route, including methods, responses, parameters, request bodies, and callbacks.

methods.name: get_fields_from_routes
methods.description: Extracts all relevant model fields from a list of routes for schema generation.

methods.name: get_openapi
methods.description: Generates the complete OpenAPI schema document for a set of FastAPI routes and webhooks.
